item.title: Write Narration From The Clip

turns.text: Watch this and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice.

item.tests: Tests deriving a grounded narration from an attached clip and delivering it mixed into the original video with the original dialogue removed.

answer_sheet.What the narration should describe: The two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine.
answer_sheet.Original sound: Remove the original conversation and replace it with narration.
answer_sheet.Video duration and framing: Keep all 10 seconds and preserve the source framing and sequence.
answer_sheet.Music, captions, and lip synchronization: No music or captions; do not alter the footage to match the narrator's mouth movements.

must_haves: The final video retains the original two coworkers, office setting, shot sequence, and 10-second duration.
An intelligible English narrator explains that the coworkers are discussing a schedule change and that Mondays now start at nine.
The narration does not invent names, job roles, or additional schedule changes unsupported by the clip.
The original man-and-woman conversation is no longer audible beneath the narration.
The narration fits within the video without a clipped ending, and no music or captions are added.

turns.text: Watch this clip and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t run any generation or spent any credits.**

Your request needs an **audio-only replacement**: keep the original 10 seconds of video, remove the conversation, and add a friendly English narration—with no music or captions. Video regeneration or lip-sync would change the footage, so neither is appropriate.

Two limitations with the connected tools:
- I can’t watch the clip from the supplied Magic Hour file path, so I shouldn’t invent what happens.
- There isn’t an exposed tool for replacing an existing video’s soundtrack while preserving its footage unchanged. **I can’t give you a verified end-to-end Magic Hour quote for this exact job.**

For reference, the production narration tool lists **24 credits per second of narration**: 120 credits for 5 seconds or 240 for 10 seconds. That is **not a quote for completing your edit**, and I won’t launch it.

### Cheaper options
- **Lowest cost:** I write the script for free; you record it yourself or use a free text-to-speech option, then replace the audio in a free video editor. No Magic Hour generation credits needed.
- **Shorter narration:** A 4–5-second voice-over can sit within the full 10-second clip, with silence elsewhere. The footage needn’t be shortened.
- **Smaller video:** Lowering resolution shouldn’t reduce narration costs and would compromise your unchanged-footage requirement.

Please upload a directly viewable copy of the clip here, or briefly describe what happens. I can then write the short narration without spending credits.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

dialog.user: The clip shows two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine. Pick the narration wording and voice, keeping it friendly and matter-of-fact.

turns.agent:
**Narration:** “Two coworkers are going over the new schedule, including a nine o’clock start on Monday.”

**Voice:** Warm, conversational English with a neutral accent and a friendly, matter-of-fact delivery. Read at an easy pace—about 7–8 seconds.

For the **0-credit option**, record this yourself or use free text-to-speech. In a free video editor, mute the original conversation and add the recording at the start. Keep the full 10-second video track untouched, with silence after the narration, no music, and no captions.

No generation has run or credits been spent.
